newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez to take big loss on sale -- report.
newsitem.headline: Suez to take big loss on sale -- report.

text.p: French finacial group Cie de Suez is likely to take a 2.0 to 2.5 billion franc loss on the sale of a 4.4 billion franc portfolio of property loans, financial daily l'Agefi reported on Friday.
The sale may be announced as early as today, the paper reported. The buyer is likely to be one of three groups bidding on the portfolio, lead by Goldman Sachs, Lehman Brothers and Morgan Stanley.
The sale would be in line with an objective set out by Suez chairman Gerard Mestrallet of withdrawing completely from the property business by 2001.
